text_block_list.name: 4 Companions
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, Tap♪

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah~!! Happy New Year! Looking forward to 
working with you again this year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The new year began. Just like always, 
everyone gathered around the barbecue 
grill.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! By the way, I know the new 
year just started, but got a second?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wondering what was going on, I leaned 
forward to look.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: It's freezing! Insanely cold!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Why?! Why do we have to have a barbecue 
outside in the dead of winter?!"

text_block_list.name: High School Girl with Twintails
text_block_list.text:
It can't be helped, Tap. It's not like we 
have anywhere to hole up...

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired High School Girl
text_block_list.text:
Karaoke rooms really aren't cheap if you 
stay for too long. Ugh, this hurts...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Tch, reality really is bitter. But 
everyone... next year. Next New Year's for 
sure—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
A base! Let's get nice and cozy inside our 
very own base!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely making one before the year 
ends, so just you watch!

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah~, a base, huh~? Would be nice if we 
could get one~...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text:
“Still... I wonder. Is it really possible 
to do it within this year...?”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't seem to feel very real to them 
yet. Admittedly, having our own base does 
sound like a pipedream.
choice_data_list: I want everyone to take a look at this.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
――Huh? Trainer, what's that? What's that 
giant rolled-up paper?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I unrolled the paper I brought right in 
front of everyone. Yes, this paper was—

text_block_list.name: High School Girl with Twintails
text_block_list.text:
"Could this really be... a floor plan of 
the room?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text:
For our base? It doesn't just have the 
floor plan, but even the prospective 
location written down...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ...Heeh~.

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
There's really... a dream in this, isn't 
there...? Seeing it presented like this...

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired High School Girl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, like, maybe it'll actually come true 
someday, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Showing them the actual floor plan seemed 
to make it feel real all at once. 
Indeed...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"What is important is showing it in a 
tangible form. If you demonstrate that it 
is by no means an empty daydream..."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Treasure Island exists! It really 
does! And it's right where we're heading, 
without a doubt!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
This year, I'm gonna win and win and keep 
winning races, and I'll definitely get my 
hands on it!

text_block_list.name: 4 Companions
text_block_list.text: Oooh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her friends' excitement surged all at 
once.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Still, callin' it a day just like this 
when it's New Year's and all feels kinda 
lame."

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Right~? I really want to do something New 
Year-ish.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
All right, Navigator! Let's have ourselves 
a real blast today!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Alright, it's party time! I'll leave it to 
you to decide how wild we get!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Captain Tap has left our New Year's plans 
entirely up to me. What should we do to 
have fun?
choice_data_list: Around the World at Super High Speed
Sweets festival at the family restaurant!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Traveling around the world at ultra-high 
speed... Is that even possible? In just 
one day?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Of course, it's impossible in reality. 
However, there is a way to do it.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Aha, I see. So it's *that* rumor, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Very well. Just make sure you get 
permission to borrow it."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, so this is the VR Umulator. Tracsen 
Academy's pride and joy machine."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lined up before me were devices that 
allowed you to freely journey into virtual 
worlds.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Alright, everyone! Let's treat ourselves 
to a fleeting trip abroad!

text_block_list.name: 4 Companions
text_block_list.text: Oooh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Tap Dance City and the others set 
off on a VR world tour—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that was quite a journey! Kyoto, 
Casablanca, San Diego!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
So the world's got all kinds of towns, and 
all kinds of folks livin' in 'em, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Right, no time to waste standing around. 
New Year's is short. Gotta hustle!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep this momentum going and blaze 
through them all, everyone! We're 
traveling around the world today!

text_block_list.name: 4 Companions
text_block_list.text: Oooh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tap Dance City and the others blazed 
through cities across the globe tied to 
their destinies at top speed.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
A sweets feast at a family restaurant, 
huh. Well, that's about all we can do 
after spending all our cash.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Alright everyone, let's treat ourselves to 
a sweets feast! Order whatever you like 
today!

text_block_list.name: High School Girl with Twintails
text_block_list.text: I'll have a chocolate sundae!

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I think I'll go with the fruit sundae~.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text: —A yogurt sundae, please.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
What's going on here? Nothing but Sundaes. 
Is that trending lately?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Geez, always letting yourself get swayed. 
I'm gonna eat whatever I want!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I think I'll go with this Revolver 
Parfait.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired High School Girl
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, is Tap really gonna be able to eat 
something that huge~?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, lightweight modern stuff just ain't 
my style. I'm sticking to my own way to 
the very end!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tap Dance City leisurely enjoyed the giant 
parfait and polished it off with ease.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Shall we dance freely to our hearts' 
content? Okay. Let's heat up the deck 
together, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Let's dance the night away until we drop! 
Get wild!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! We can keep going, right?! 
Hyahaa!!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired High School Girl
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek~, I can't take it anymore~. By the 
way, why is Tap so energetic~?

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Tap~ For someone who talked about going 
wild, aren't your moves super polished?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, my teacher— my mom, that is—is a 
real-deal professional dancer, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"My roots aren't surprisingly from the 
streets. Just watch me!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tap Dance City puts on a display of varied 
moves. Her dance was inherited from her 
mother, and it was quite technical.
